title: The Cost and Usage Report and answering who spent what

videos.script: Finance asks a simple question. Who spent what last month? {{question}} Cost Explorer answers part of it. The rest is in a file underneath, the Cost and Usage Report. {{report}} The report is the bill as a table. One row for every line, with the account that used it, the resource behind it, and the tags it carried. AWS writes it into a bucket you own, and nobody reads it for you. {{lab}} Your lab has no bill, so this lesson makes a small one. A short program writes a month of made-up lines, across three accounts of the shop. {{sql}} Then you ask it questions in SQL, with a database that comes inside Python. Spend per account. Spend per team. {{remainder}} And the part that matters most: what no team's tag claims at all. {{amortised}} You will also see one cost move from nobody to a team, just by counting it a different way. The data is invented. The questions are the ones you ask of a real report. {{end}}
